quotes.text: My lyrics are so personal that people feel like they know me. So if you like my music, you really like it.

It was weird, man. You've got these expectations on you – you have this image in your of what that moment's going to be like, because it's a big one. I mean signing isn't everything, but as a kid you think it is. So we all popped on Zoom and everyone went "woo!". And then we logged off and I was like, cool. It was kind of sheltered because everyone was at home. It's not the same as being suddenly thrown into being a professional musician, when you're out in the world. So the whole thing was weird until we could play shows.
I guess it's a tale of two extremes: either you'll be on stage or you'll be at home writing in your bedroom feeling introspective.

I'm busy writing at the moment, trying to finish an album, and it is a very different thing. And you sort of use the experience from playing live in writing as well – because you write with the idea you'll be playing to a live audience. But you never know with the creative process: I was super inspired at the beginning during the first lockdown – and I've never found that same sense of productivity creating until right now.

I've had that feeling my whole life. I've got an older sister and it's a classic trope. You always feel in the shadow of someone. I felt like no one expected much from me because I was much quieter. I was at school and I had people telling me I couldn't sing. I think there's something about that that I loved… because part of my ambition came from this desire to prove people wrong. It was like a huge driving force in me to be like that's given me a lot of fire.

Like you get it from where you're going to get it from. That's something I speak to a lot. I speak a lot about that with my producer and my manager – like wherever you're going to get the inspiration from, you've gotta just accept, accept it from that place, you know?

It was pretty crazy. GQ made a top list of artists to watch in 2021, which she read. Then one day I was on Instagram and I saw "Courtney Love tagged you in a post". I went on there and she'd gone through all my songs and said exactly what she thought about them. And I was like, What the hell? This is crazy. I mean, because she's just the biggest icon ever. So we got chatting and she invited me round. It gives you so much confidence when somebody that like – who has seen so much and has lived through so much of the music industry and has known so many incredible musicians – turns around and says, your lyrics are amazing. It definitely gave me loads of confidence, man. She's one of the most intelligent and well-versed…
